explanation: The short complex Zᵢ ⟶ Kᵢ ⟶ Zⱼ (built from iCycles i, toCycles i j and iCycles_toCycles) is the library's own definition. Grepping Mathlib for cyclesShortComplex, iCycles_toCycles and `ShortComplex.mk (K.iCycles` gave no matches. The toCycles/iCycles exactness results in HomologySequence.lean (composableArrows₃_exact, cycles_left_exact, opcycles_right_exact, the homology_exact lemmas) cover other sequences. I found no lemma stating that iCycles i is a kernel of toCycles i j. The nearest general tool is ShortComplex.exact_of_f_is_kernel, but using it needs the kernel property first, which takes isKernelOfComp, HomologicalComplex.cyclesIsKernel and toCycles_i. That combines several substantial Mathlib results, so it is not a special case of one declaration.
